primitives.name: search
primitives.subtask: Search Medical Records for 'Knee pain after hiking trip'

primitives.name: create_by_form
primitives.subtask: Write the WebMail email to Dr. Chang summarizing the recorded recommendations

steps.action: Click the “Search records and messages by keyword…” field
Click the “Search records and messages by keyword…” field
Type “Knee pain after hiking trip” in the “Search records and messages by keyword…” field
Click “RE: Knee pain after hiking trip”

Type “Hi Dr. Chang,

Hope you've been having a great summer!

I wanted to send a quick follow-up note regarding my right knee since our last visit back in February.
Physical Therapy Progress: Working with Daniel (my neighbor) went amazingly well. We wrapped up the formal strengthening program in late spring, focusing heavily on hip stability and eccentric quad work.
Current Symptoms: The pain going up and down stairs is completely gone, and long days at my desk are no longer causing that persistent ache. No swelling or instability whatsoever.
Activity Update: I’ve gradually built my mileage back up on moderate, flatter trails over the last couple of months with zero flare-ups.
I’m looking to tackle a steeper, high-elevation hike again before the season ends next month. Is there anything specific you’d recommend I keep in mind (or use, like trekking poles/knee support) as I head back into steeper descents, or am I all clear to proceed as normal?

Thanks again for all your help getting me back on track!

Best,

Alex Rivera” in the “Write your message...” field
Type “6-Month Knee Update & Late-Summer Hiking Clearance — Alex Rivera” in the “Subject” field
